_comment: Copy to ~/.claude-code-docs/digest-targets.json and fill in real ids. Two independent uses of the same per-plugin entry: `manifestPath` is read by gather.mjs (an extra manifest for a plugin not discoverable via the normal plugin-cache scan); `boardId`/`listId`/`atriumMention` are read by the digest skill's delivery step (step 4) to pick a Planka board/list and an Atrium mention for that plugin. Neither reader errors on a key it doesn't use, and either half may be present without the other.
